name: Clef
description: A clef sitting astride its stave: a bold curl over four ruled lines.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 16%; width: 100%; height: 68%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 22%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 22%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 26%; top: 6%; width: 48%; height: 88%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); @shape: clover 3; -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
